text.S1: Once upon a time, there were three little pigs. One day, they left their mother to go see the world. All summer long, they made lots of friends. The third little pig, unlike his brothers, remembered his mother’s advice that they should work hard to succeed in life. “We need to build a house to shelter us from the cold during winter and also to protect us from the big bad wolf”. However, each little pig took the decision to build a house for himself.

text.T1: Kalekale, panali nkhumba zitatu zazing’ono. Tsiku lina, adasiya amai awo kuti apita kukayendera dziko. Nthawi yonse ya dzinja, anapalana cibwenzi ndi anthu ambiri. Nkhumba yachitatu yaying’ono, mosiyana ndi azikulu ake, inakumbukira malangizo ya amai ake kuti afunika kugwira nchito ndi mphamvu ngati ufuna kukhala bwino. ‘’Tifunika kupanga nyumba kuti izitichingiriza kulimphepo mnthawi yacisanu komanso kuti titezedwe nkhandwe yaikulu yoipa. Ngakhale zinalitero, nkhumba yaying’ono iliyonse inaganiza kumanga nyumba yakeyake.

text.S1: The first little pig, the laziest of the three, decided to build a nice little straw house. “As it will take only a day to build, I will have plenty of time to play!” he said. “Yes, but it will not be strong enough,” said the second little pig, and added, “I’m going to build a house of wood.” “And me, I’ll build my house of brick,” said the third little pig. “I’m afraid that neither the house built of straw nor the house built of wood are strong enough to keep the big bad wolf away.” The first and second little pigs didn’t take advice from the third little pig and they all built their houses the way they thought best.

text.T1: Nkhumba yoyamba yaying’ono, yaulesi pa nkhumba zitatu, inaganiza kumanga kanyumba kabwino kamapesi. ‘’Pakuti cidzanditengera tsiku limodzi kumanga, ndidzakhala ndi nthawi yambiri kusewera’’ anatero. ‘’Koma sidzakhala yolimba kwambiri’’, nkhumba yaciwiri yaying’ono inalankhula. ‘Ndidzamanga numba yamatabwa’ ‘’Ndipo ine, ndidzamanga nyumba yanjerwa,’’nkhumba yacitatu yaing’ono inanena. Ninvera mantha kuti nyumba yomangidwa ndimapesi kapena ndi mitengo siyolimba kwambiri kuteteza nkhandwe yaikulu.’’ Nkhumba yoyamba ndiyachiwiri yaying’ono alibe utenga uphungu kucokera kulinkhumba yachitatu yaying’ono pakuti onse anamanga nyumba momwe anaganizira.

text.S1: But the next day the big bad wolf came. The wolf was hungry and wanted a delicious pig for dinner. “Come out, I want to speak to you,” roared the big bad wolf to the house of straw. “No way, I would rather stay where I am,” replied the first little pig in a weak voice. “I’ll make you come out, whether you like it or not,” growled the big bad wolf, and he blew with all his strength. The fragile little straw house soon fell down. There was only one thing the first little pig could do and that was to flee.

Nyama ija inali ndi njala ndipo inafuna nkhumba yotsekemera monga chakudya cha madzulo.’’Tuluka, ndifuna kukamba nd iiwe,nyama yoyipayo yopysa inabangu lakunyumba yomangidwa ndi mapesi.’’ Chosatheka icho, ndichabwino kukhala mwamene ndiliri,’’ nkhumba yaying’ono inayankha ndimauyofoka.’’Ndidzakupangitsa kuti utuluke, ufunasiufuna,’’ chilombo choyipa chija chinabangula, ndipo chinafuzira mphweya ndimphamvu zake zonse. Kanyumba akang’ono kofooka kanagwa pansi mosachedwa. Panali chinthu chimodzi comwe kankhumba kakang’ono kanalikufunika kuchita kuthawa chabe.

text.S1: The first little pig ran to take shelter in the wooden house of the second little pig. The big bad wolf grew angrier and within a few minutes approached the second little pig’s wooden house. “It’s two little pigs that I will have now,” he thought. He banged on the door and shouted, “I’ll get you, and you shall not escape me.” “I hope that your house will stand better than mine,” said the worried first little pig to the second little pig. Seeing that he could not get in, the big bad wolf stepped back, puffed up his lungs and blew with all his might. The wooden house didn’t take much longer than the straw house to fall down. It collapsed plank by plank and the two little pigs started to run as fast as they could.

text.T1: Nkhumba yaying’ono yoyamba inathamangira kunyumba yamitengo komwe kunali nkhumba yaying’ono yaciwiri kukabisala. Chilombo choopysa chachikulu chinakalipa kwambiri ndipo poasapita mphindi zambiri chinafika kuchumba kunali nkhumba yachiwiri m’nyumba yamitengo.’’Ndi nkhumba ziwiri zazing’ono zomwe ndifuna tsopano’’ chilombo chinaganiza. Chilombo chinagogoda pakhomo ndipo chinakuwa,’’ ndidzakupeza ndipo sudzandithawa’’, ‘’Ndikhulupirira kuti nyumba yako ndiyolimba kupambana yanga,’’ inalankula nkhumba yaying’ono yoyamba kuwuza nkhumba yaying’ono yachiwiri. Powona kuti sangalowe m’nyumba, chilombo choopysa, chinafutuka, ndikukoka mphweya m’mapwapwa ake ndikutulutsa ndi mphamvu zake zonse. Nyumba yomangidwa ndi mitengo ilibe kutenga nthawi poyereka ndi nyumba yamapesi kugwa. Inagwa pulanga imodziimodzi ndipo nkhumba ziwiri zazing’ono zinayamba kuthamanga liwiro lamtondo wadowoka.

text.S1: They arrive at their brother’s house, the third little pig. Just in time, because the wolf was about to catch them. “Come in! Quick, quick!” he screamed. “I told you that your houses wouldn’t stand!” By now, the big bad wolf was getting increasingly hungry and angry. He tried to break open the door but only succeeded in hurting his legs. The third little pig reassured his brothers, “We are safe here. This house is very solid. The big bad wolf won’t be able to destroy it.” Indeed, the big bad wolf didn’t know what to do. He grew restless and kicked the door and the walls all over but neither the door nor the wall moved by an inch!

text.T1: Zinafika panyumba pa m’bale wawo, nkhumba yachitatu yaying’ono, panthawiyake, chifukwa chilombo chinali pafupi kugwira nkhumbazo.’’Lowani, mwamsanga, msanga’’, anakuwa. ‘’Ndinakuwuzani kuti manyumba yanu ndiyosalimba’’. Tsopano, chilombo coipa chinali kuvera njala ndi ukali kwambiri. Chilombo chinayesa kuphwanya chitseko koma chidziphweka miyendo yake. Nkhumba yachitatu yaying’ono inatsimikizira abale ake kuti ‘’, palibe chidzachitika pano. Ino nyumba ndiyolimba. Chilombo choipa sichidzakwaniritsa kuwononga’’. Zoona, chilombo choyipa sichinadziwe chochita. Chilombo chinatangwanika ndi kumenyachitseko ndi zipupa koma ngakhale zinalitero chitseko kapena chipupa chilibe kunyang’anyanga khale panushu.

text.S1: And he began to blow and blow, and blow during long minutes, but the house still stood. The third little pig opened the window carefully and saw that the big bad wolf looked completely exhausted. This made the three little pigs laugh and they felt perfectly safe now.

text.S1: But the big bad wolf wasn’t finished talking. “Don’t think I’m giving up,” said the big bad wolf. “I’m really hungry now!” The wolf was thinking. If he can’t destroy the house, there must be a way to get in. “Maybe in disguise?” wondered the wolf. “If they don’t recognize me, there might be a chance they open the door”, he said. “Oh no! These 3 little pigs are too smart, they’ll recognize me! I need to think of something else!” He saw the ladder that had been used by the third little pig to build his house. “That’s what I’ll do,” thought the big bad wolf, “I’ll go down using the chimney.” And he climbed on to the roof.

text.S1: The third little pig was very clever. He had seen the wolf’s move and said to his brothers: “I believe that the wolf is on the roof and he is going to try coming down the chimney! Quick, light the fire.” The wolf was already in the chimney and wasn’t able to climb up, so he slid down the chimney. He landed on the fire and burnt his backside and tail. He shrieked and ran away as fast as he could, through the door that the third little pig had left deliberately open.

text.T1: Nkhumba yachitatu yaying’ono inali yocenjera kwambiri. Inawona zomwe chilombo chimachita ndipo anati kuli azikuluake; ‘’ ndikhulupirira kuti chilombo chili pa denga ndipo chijayesetsa kulowera kotulukira utsi.Mwamsanga, yatsani moto’’. Chilombo chinali chitalowa kale kotulukira utsi ndipo sichinakwaniritse kukwera, motero chilombo chinaterera ndikugwera kotulukira utsi. Chinagwera pamoto ndikudzitentha kumsana ndi kumchila. Chinakwinyata ndikuthawa mwamsangamsanga, kuchokera kuchitseko komwe nkhumba yachitatu yaying’ono idasiyira dala kotsekuka.
